relationships.subject: NRP-1 CendR site inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: All 10 of our tested compounds significantly blocked the VEGF-A stimulated increased phosphorylation of VEGFR2 (Figure 7C).

relationships.subject: SARS-CoV-2 Spike protein
relationships.evidence_quote: which could be blocked by SARS-CoV-2 Spike protein as well as by the reference compound EG00229 (Figure 7C)

key_findings: Virtual screening of ~0.5 million compounds identified nine chemical series targeting the VEGF-A binding (CendR) site on NRP-1; six compounds disrupted VEGF-A/NRP-1 binding more effectively than EG00229.
All tested compounds blocked VEGF-A-stimulated VEGFR2 phosphorylation and two inhibited Spike-dependent viral entry.
